# Fixture brain root — offline fixture

Not a real knowledge base. This is the smallest tree that still exercises every
convention `/megavault` depends on: a router table, a prefixed vault, a decoy
`qa/` note whose basename a later publish test will try to reuse.

## Router — which question goes to which vault

| Vault | When to look here | Entry point |
|---|---|---|
| `qa/` | Hand-written answers kept outside any vault | flat folder |
| `mini/` | Light level, watering interval, pot types — the fixture vault | `00 Mini Home.md` |
